title: AbbVie’s Q3 beat should keep ‘train rolling’ as company eyes bolt-on deals
snippet: Strong immunology and neuroscience sales fueled AbbVie’s latest quarterly beat as the pharma’s stock continues to hit all-time highs.

title: AstraZeneca employs $1.5B cost savings to reinvest back into growth
snippet: “You don't spend one and a half billion dollars without creating jobs,” AstraZeneca CEO Pascal Soriot said as the pharma announced a new cost savings program alongside third quarter earnings.

title: Regeneron achieves ‘clean sweep’ in Q3 with myriad pipeline catalysts on deck
snippet: Regeneron executives struck an upbeat tone on an investor call Friday as the biotech posted a consensus-beating $5.1 billion in third quarter earnings and CEO Leonard Schleifer touted the company’s ‘disease agnostic’ pipeline and approach to business development.

title: Sanofi targets late-phase and commercial M&A to offset looming Dupixent decline
snippet: Focused on ensuring growth beyond Dupixent, Sanofi wants to acquire derisked assets that may benefit from the French pharma’s commercial capabilities, executives said on Friday as they reported third-quarter earnings.

title: Acumen scraps sole asset after Alzheimer’s fail, plunging stock 80%
snippet: Acumen will implement cash-saving strategies and assess its options after sabirnetug failed to beat placebo, leaving the biotech without a clinical program.

title: ‘We need to do better,’ Alnylam CEO admits, as uncertainty looms over transthyretin franchise
snippet: Alnylam shares dropped by a quarter on Thursday, with analysts suggesting the decline puts the RNAi specialist within range for a takeout.

title: Once undruggable, the Wnt/B-catenin pathway shows increasing promise
snippet: Early-stage clinical data from our company and others point to the Wnt/β-catenin pathway as a new avenue for targeting multiple cancer types.
